answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the cedar queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. The jetty index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1402 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the sparrow. A farm of 104 pays that 31 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
